title: Royal colours of Rajasthan
alt: A palace courtyard in Rajasthan at sunset
description: Step into a storybook of forts, desert skies, and vibrant markets. This route balances heritage with a laid-back sense of adventure.

itinerary.title: Arrival in the capital
itinerary.text: Reach Jaipur and ease into the trip with an afternoon of market and monument views.

itinerary.title: Pink city moments
itinerary.text: Visit the city’s iconic forts and palaces, then spend time exploring local lanes and cafés.

itinerary.title: Into the desert state
itinerary.text: Travel to Jodhpur for a slower pace, rooftop views, and a sunset by the city walls.

itinerary.title: Lake city charm
itinerary.text: Continue to Udaipur to enjoy a scenic evening by the water and a relaxed dinner.

itinerary.title: Final day, last look
itinerary.text: Keep the morning flexible with an optional heritage walk before departure.
